title: Netherite Tools Recoloured
description: A simple texture pack that recolors all Netherite tools while keeping the original vanilla style.
body:
This texture pack recolors all Netherite tools to give them a fresh and unique look while keeping the vanilla look unchanged.The changes are simple and clean,making the tools look more refined without breaking the vanilla feel or overall gameplay experience.

![Comparison: Vanilla vs Netherite Recoloured](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8470483a0efa0e6fd83bff20a1fa06010edd156.png)
